title: Bohemian Rhapsody
description: Official Easy Piano arrangement by Phillip Keveren (Hal Leonard / MuseScore). Transposed to C major so every note is approachable on the white keys.
generalTip: Key of C major (all natural white keys!). Follow the finger numbers in the tips. Keep the tempo steady and relaxed at 72 BPM.

sections.label: Intro & "Mama, just killed a man"
tips: 🎹 Start with the flowing C major intro: C E G c — feel the gentle rocking pulse
👆 Finger 3 on C for "Ma-ma" (bars 3–4): c6 d2 | c2 B2 A4
🎵 "Put a gun against his head": e e e d c d | e d d4

sections.label: "Life had just begun"
tips: 👆 Finger 1 on E, Finger 2 on G for "life had" — then reach up to high A with Finger 3 or 5
🎵 "Now I've gone and thrown it all away": rapid repeated A notes before settling on low G
✨ Let the final G ring for the full 4 beats — feel the regret in the harmony

sections.label: "Mama, ooh..."
tips: 💧 Finger 3 on F for "Ma-ma" — notice how shifting to F gives this phrase its tender, weeping quality
🎤 "Didn't mean to make you cry": step down smoothly from A to G to F to E
🕊️ "If I'm not back again this time tomorrow": gentle eighth-note pulse moving forward

sections.label: "Carry on" & Outro
tips: 💪 "Carry on, carry on": uplifting repeated motif E-C | E-C
🕊️ The gentle, reflective outro — slower and quieter (piano / pp)
🏁 Ends softly on C — "Any way the wind blows..."
